achievements.name: Rite of Passage
achievements.description: Safely return to Speranza for the first time.

steps: Load into any map and complete a run.
Reach an extraction point and extract safely to return to Speranza.

achievements.name: Shots Fired
achievements.description: Deal 1000 damage to ARC enemies.

steps: Shoot any ARC machines you encounter.
Damage is tracked across runs until you reach 1,000.

achievements.name: Mechanical Failure
achievements.description: Shoot a thruster off a Wasp.

steps: Target a Wasp — the small flying ARC drone.
Aim at one of its thrusters and shoot it off.

achievements.name: Self-Sufficient
achievements.description: Install a station in your Workshop.

steps: Open your Workshop in Speranza.
Install any crafting station you have a blueprint for.

achievements.name: The Friends We Made Along The Way
achievements.description: Return to Speranza together with an encountered Raider.

steps: Find another player's Raider in a run — 'encountered' means someone outside your party, even in fill squad mode.
Extract together from the same extraction point so both of you return to Speranza.

achievements.name: Scavenger
achievements.description: Search 50 loot containers.

steps: Open loot containers and search them.
A container can only be searched once, so sweep buildings each run until you reach 50.

achievements.name: Crossed the Threshold
achievements.description: Knock out a Raider.

steps: Down another player's Raider in combat.
Finish them off — or force a surrender — so they are knocked out, not merely downed.
warnings: Downing a Raider is not enough. Once downed they must lose all their health or surrender for the knockout to count.

achievements.name: In Your Element
achievements.description: Reach level 10.

steps: Earn XP by looting, destroying ARC and completing quests.
Level up until you reach level 10.

achievements.name: Not Over Till It's Over
achievements.description: Safely return to Speranza while downed.

steps: Get downed near an extraction point.
Call the extract while downed and crawl into the extract zone.
Return to Speranza while still downed — do not bleed out first.

achievements.name: Behind Closed Doors
achievements.description: Visit a locked room on Dam Battlegrounds, Buried City or Spaceport.

steps: Find a locked room on Dam Battlegrounds, Buried City or Spaceport.
Open it with the matching key (e.g. a Controlled Access Zone Key) or wait for it to be unlocked.
Step inside the room.

achievements.name: Into Thin Air
achievements.description: Safely return to Speranza through a Raider Hatch.

steps: Bring a Raider Hatch Key (bought in Speranza or looted) into a run.
Find a Raider Hatch and extract through it to return to Speranza.
warnings: Raider Hatches are disabled during Night Raids.

achievements.name: Well-Traveled
achievements.description: Safely return from Dam Battlegrounds, Buried City and Spaceport.

steps: Extract successfully from Dam Battlegrounds.
Extract successfully from Buried City.
Extract successfully from Spaceport.

achievements.name: Racking Them Up
achievements.description: Destroy 50 ARC enemies.

steps: Destroy any ARC machines.
The count is lifetime, so keep destroying until you reach 50.

achievements.name: Well-Armed
achievements.description: Have two weapons of Tier II or higher equipped in a round.

steps: Upgrade or craft two weapons to Tier II or higher.
Equip both at the same time during a run.

achievements.name: See You Never
achievements.description: Return safely to Speranza while leaving a squadmate behind.

steps: Play with at least one squadmate.
Reach an extraction point and extract while your squadmate stays behind — a Raider Hatch makes this easy since you exit before them.
Return to Speranza on your own.
warnings: The squadmate left behind must still be alive when you extract.
Reported as buggy for some players — it may take more than one attempt.

achievements.name: Bells and Whistles
achievements.description: Have 4 weapon mods on a single weapon.

steps: Install four weapon mods on the same weapon.
It must be a single weapon, not four mods spread across your loadout.

achievements.name: Getting Serious
achievements.description: Upgrade a Workshop station to level 2.

steps: Open a Workshop station in Speranza.
Spend the materials to upgrade it to level 2.

achievements.name: Trail of Destruction
achievements.description: Destroy 100 ARC enemies.

steps: Destroy ARC machines across runs.
The count is lifetime, so keep going until you reach 100.

achievements.name: Expert Weaponsmith
achievements.description: Upgrade a weapon to Tier IV.

steps: Upgrade a weapon repeatedly at the Gunsmith.
Reach Tier IV, the top upgrade tier.

achievements.name: The Big Haul
achievements.description: Return to Speranza with 50 000 worth of loot.

steps: Fill your inventory with high-value loot — your total loot value is shown in the inventory screen.
Extract with at least 50,000 total value.
warnings: You lose everything outside your safe pockets if you are knocked out before extracting.

achievements.name: A Vendetta Is Born
achievements.description: Get downed and knocked out while inside a return point.

steps: Go to a standard extraction point — Raider Hatches do not work.
Let an ARC enemy down you right at the point (a solo method that avoids PvP).
While downed, press the button to call the extract and crawl around inside the zone.
Stay inside until you bleed out and are knocked out — that is what unlocks it.
warnings: You must be knocked out (not extracted) while inside the return point.
Bring a free/low-cost loadout — being knocked out loses anything not in a safe pocket.

achievements.name: The Long Haul
achievements.description: Reach a total lifetime loot value of 1 000 000.

steps: Extract loot repeatedly — the total is lifetime and accumulates across runs.
Keep farming high-value loot runs until you reach 1,000,000.

achievements.name: Unyielding
achievements.description: Knock out 10 Raiders.

steps: Down other players' Raiders in combat.
Finish them so they are knocked out, not merely downed.
Repeat until you have knocked out 10.
warnings: Downing is not enough — a Raider must lose all health or surrender to count.

achievements.name: No Going Back
achievements.description: Be topside when the safe window closes.

steps: Stay on the surface until the round timer is nearly out.
Call an elevator (or open a Raider Hatch) in the final seconds and extract as the safe window closes.
warnings: Being caught in the open as the timer hits zero kills you — start the extract first.
Pairs naturally with In the Nick of Time.
Raider Hatches are disabled during Night Raids.

achievements.name: Bringing Down the Big Guns
achievements.description: Destroy a Rocketeer.

steps: Find a Rocketeer — the large flying ARC enemy.
Target its engines and other weak spots and destroy it.

achievements.name: Top of the World
achievements.description: Reach the top of the Launch Towers in Spaceport.

steps: On the Spaceport map, find the Launch Towers — the tallest buildings, marked on the map.
Take the zipline up to the control room just below the top.
Enter the room; the achievement pops there.
warnings: The control room may need a key from a quest or loot, or may already be open.
Expect heavy ARC and camping Raiders — bring smoke and a squad.

achievements.name: Back from the Brink
achievements.description: Revive a squadmate ten times.

steps: Play with a squad.
Revive downed squadmates whenever they fall.
Revives accumulate across runs until you reach ten.

achievements.name: Long Shot
achievements.description: Hit a target over 250 meters away.

steps: Equip a long-range weapon with a scope.
Find a target over 250 metres away (a stationary ARC machine is easiest) and land a hit.

achievements.name: Same Song, Same Verse
achievements.description: Set off two car alarms in a single round.

steps: Find car alarms on the map by searching vehicles.
Set off two of the same kind of alarm within a single run.
warnings: Both alarms must be the same kind of alarm.

achievements.name: Into the Breach
achievements.description: Destroy a Bastion.

steps: Find a Bastion — the large, heavily armoured ground ARC enemy.
Attack its weak spots and destroy it.

achievements.name: In the Nick of Time
achievements.description: Safely return to Speranza with less than 5 seconds left in the round.

steps: Call an extraction point (or open a Raider Hatch) as the round timer runs down.
Enter the extraction zone with less than 5 seconds left and return to Speranza.
warnings: Call the extract before the timer hits zero — being caught in the open when it does kills you.

achievements.name: Horseshoes and Hand Grenades
achievements.description: Down an encountered Raider with a grenade.

steps: Equip a grenade.
Down another player's Raider with the grenade.

achievements.name: Snitches get Stitches
achievements.description: Destroy a Snitch with a Stitcher.

steps: Equip a Stitcher weapon.
Find a Snitch — the small scanning drone — and destroy it with the Stitcher.

achievements.name: Escape Artist
achievements.description: Safely return to Speranza 100 times.

steps: Extract successfully from any map.
The count is lifetime, so keep extracting until you reach 100.

achievements.name: Heart of Gold
achievements.description: Be thanked 10 times in direct response to something you did.

steps: Help other players — revive them, share loot, or assist in a fight.
When prompted, they press the thank key to thank you.
Thanks accumulate until you reach 10.
warnings: The 'Thanks' emote does not count — the other player must press the prompted thank key in response to something you did.

achievements.name: Today You, Tomorrow Me
achievements.description: Revive an encountered Raider with a Defibrillator.

steps: Bring a Defibrillator into a run.
Find a downed player who is not your own squadmate and revive them with the Defibrillator.

achievements.name: Practice Makes Perfect
achievements.description: Visit the Practice Range.

steps: From Speranza, travel to the Practice Range.
Stepping inside unlocks it.

achievements.name: Dedicated to the Craft
achievements.description: Have five stations upgraded to level 3 or higher.

steps: Upgrade Workshop stations in Speranza.
Get five different stations to level 3 or higher.

achievements.name: Three Birds, One Stone
achievements.description: Destroy 3 ARC enemies with a single Wolfpack grenade.

steps: Equip a Wolfpack grenade.
Wait for at least three small ARC enemies to cluster, then throw the grenade to destroy all three at once.

achievements.name: Legend of Speranza
achievements.description: Reach level 75.

steps: Earn XP through quests, looting and combat.
Grind to the maximum level, 75.

achievements.name: Up Close and Personal
achievements.description: Knock out a Raider with a Raider Tool.

steps: Down another player's Raider.
Finish them off with a melee hit from a Raider Tool, such as your hammer.
warnings: The Raider must be knocked out with the tool — downing alone does not count.

achievements.name: Comparative Study
achievements.description: Use 4 different weapons to deal damage in the Practice Range.

steps: At the Practice Range, pick up and fire four different weapons.
Deal damage with each one.

achievements.name: Most Durable Pants in Speranza
achievements.description: Slide 80 meters without stopping.

steps: Find a long downhill slope, for example on Dam Battlegrounds or Spaceport.
Start a slide and keep it going for 80 metres without stopping.

achievements.name: Hook, Line, and Sinker
achievements.description: Use a Lure Grenade to make a drone attack another drone.

steps: Equip a Lure Grenade.
Throw it to lure one drone into attacking another drone.
warnings: Reported as buggy — it may need several attempts before it pops.

achievements.name: A Tale for the Ages
achievements.description: Destroy the Queen.

steps: Trigger the Harvester event and bring heavy weapons — a Hullcracker with plenty of ammo, plus blue-tier shields and healing.
Fight the Queen from cover, targeting her leg joints and the exposed weak spot on top when it opens.
Land the killing blow yourself — only the final hit counts.
warnings: Only the player who lands the final blow gets the achievement.
Other Raiders usually rush the Queen — you may need to steal the last hit or fight alone.
The Queen hits extremely hard; her laser can one-shot medium shields, so bring a team.

achievements.name: Blindsided
achievements.description: Destroy a Sentinel with a Raider Tool.

steps: Find a large standing Sentinel turret — Dam Battlegrounds and Spaceport are reliable spots.
Weaken it with gunfire if needed, but land the killing hit with a Raider Tool (hammer).
Melee it until it is destroyed.
warnings: Reported as buggy — it may take several attempts before it pops.
Wall-mounted turrets do not count; use the large standing Sentinels.
The turret can knock you off the ledge as you swing.

achievements.name: Death From Above
achievements.description: Deal 50 damage to any enemy while atop a Rocketeer.

steps: Stun a Rocketeer so it falls to the ground — a Hornet Driver, Jolt Mine or Showstopper grenade works.
Climb on top of it and shoot an enemy (or the Rocketeer itself) to deal 50 damage.
Jump periodically so it cannot flip you off.
warnings: The older trick of standing on a destroyed Rocketeer husk was patched out — use a live one.

achievements.name: Just Dropping In
achievements.description: Get hit by a Supply Drop.

steps: Find a Supply Drop call station (a tall antenna with a light) and interact with it to fire a flare.
Stand directly under the drifting flare and hold position.
When the crate lands on you the achievement unlocks — it deals no damage.
warnings: You must be directly under the flare; the crate does no damage but misses if you drift.
Stations often sit on rooftops — use ziplines to reposition in time.

achievements.name: For Science!
achievements.description: Get gas, stun, and burn statuses at the same time.

steps: Bring a stun source (Jolt Mine or Hornet Driver), a gas source (Gas Grenade or Gas Mine) and a burn source (Blaze Grenade or Fireball Burner).
On flat ground, place the Jolt Mine and throw the Gas Grenade at your feet.
Throw the Blaze Grenade or fire the Burner onto the same spot and stand in it so gas, stun and burn apply together.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: the stun grenade tends to bounce — throw it straight down at your feet rather than at a target.
Reddit tip: gas is often called the weak link; stack the Jolt Mine, the gas source and the fire source on one flat spot and step into all three.
warnings: Flagged as buggy — it can fail to pop even when done correctly; retry, sometimes it pops only after you extract.
Gas Grenades and Jolt Mines can be bought from Apollo or crafted; bring a green shield so the burn does not kill you first.

achievements.name: Enemy of My Enemy
achievements.description: Get an encountered Raider downed by ARC enemies summoned with a Snitch Scanner.

steps: Kill Snitches (the scanning drones) and harvest their Snitch Scanners; stockpile a few.
Find an enemy Raider — ideally one already fighting ARC — and throw the Scanner(s) onto or near them.
Lure Grenades can help enrage the ARC; the Raider must be downed by the summoned ARC.
The achievement unlocks once the ARC downs the Raider.
warnings: Formerly broken — it is patched and working now, but it is the rarest achievement in the game.
The Raider only needs to be downed, not killed.
